original_test_intent: Retrain each approved PCIe endpoint link 10,000 times to its maximum supported generation and prove every cycle restores expected speed/width, driver operation and error-free service.
original_method: Pin vendor module/config; map link/endpoint allowlist and each maximum speed; exclude critical shared paths; baseline link/AER/I/O; approve timing and per-cycle oracle; drain I/O; run with first-failure stop; preserve every retrain result and restore services/health.
manual_activity: PCIe owner approves link targets, maximum-speed matrix and maintenance window; operator protects I/O and owns recovery.
safety_requirements: Stop on first failed retrain, AER, I/O or management anomaly
No automatic retry or log clearing
